description: The two deadlines of a 1031 like-kind exchange from the date the relinquished property was transferred: day 45 to identify replacement property, and the end of the exchange period, which is the earlier of day 180 or the due date (with extensions) of the tax return for the year of the transfer. Calendar arithmetic is where these go wrong: day 1 is the day after the transfer, a deadline on a weekend or holiday stays where it falls, and a late-year transfer can lose weeks to an unextended return. Send transfer_date as YYYY-MM-DD and, when day 180 may fall after the return is due, return_due_date; without it, the answer names both candidate dates and the missing input.

return_due_date.description: Due date, with extensions, of the tax return for the year of the transfer, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2027-10-15

transfer_date.description: Date the relinquished property was transferred, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-11-19

name: compute_1031_deadlines
title: 1031 exchange deadlines
